name: How do tenant leases affect the sale of my rental property?

mainEntity.name: How do tenant leases affect the sale of my rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tenant leases dictate the terms of occupancy and can significantly impact your sale. A lease typically transfers with the property to the new owner, meaning the buyer must honor its duration and terms. If the lease is month-to-month, it offers more flexibility for an owner-occupant buyer. Understanding these lease conditions is a key preparation step before listing. Kelby Contreras can review existing leases to strategize the best approach for marketing your property to potential buyers in Florida.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tenant leases transfer with the property and dictate occupancy terms, impacting buyer appeal. Understanding these terms is a key preparation step.
